title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第1题：请问是谁钓到了那条鱼？

content.en: Who catches the ﬁsh? Siapakah yang menangkap ikan tersebut?
content.zh: 请问是谁钓到了那条鱼？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q2: In the picture there are…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第2题：图中有数个5 角星、6…

content.en: In the picture there are 5-pointed, 6-pointed and 7-pointed stars. How many 5-pointed stars are there? Pada gambar berikut terdapat bintang dengan 5 bucu, 6 bucu dan 7 bucu.
content.zh: 图中有数个5 角星、6 角星和7 角星。请问图中有多少个5 角星？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q3: The cake in the picture is…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第3题：图中的蛋糕被切后平分给了几位小朋…

content.en: The cake in the picture is cut and divided among some children. Each child receives a piece of the cake with three cherries on top. How many children are there? Kek pada gambar berikut dipotong dan dibahagikan kepada beberapa orang kanak-kanak.
content.zh: 图中的蛋糕被切后平分给了几位小朋友。每一位小朋友都获得了一块有三颗樱桃的蛋 糕。请问共有几位小朋友？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q4: If we cut along the dotted…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第4题：请问如果我们依着这条直线剪，这条…

content.en: If we cut along the dotted line, how many parts will the rope split into? Jika kita memotong mengikut garisan putus-putus, berapakah bahagian tali yang akan ter- hasil?
content.zh: 请问如果我们依着这条直线剪，这条绳子会被切成几个部分？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q5: Ellen wants to decorate the…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第5题：Ellen…

content.en: Ellen wants to decorate the butterﬂy with the given stickers. Which butterﬂy can she make? Ellen mahu menghias rama-rama berikut menggunakan pelekat yang diberikan. Rama-rama
content.zh: Ellen 想要用这些贴纸设计这只蝴蝶。请问她可以设计出哪只蝴蝶？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q6: How many bricks like this…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第6题：请问这个雪屋缺少几个像…

content.en: How many bricks like this are missing in the igloo? Berapakah bilangan bata berbentuk seperti ini
content.zh: 请问这个雪屋缺少几个像 这样的砖块？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q7: In the picture we see a…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第7题：图中我们看见一条线串着四颗珠子。…

content.zh: 图中我们看见一条线串着四颗珠子。请问以下哪条线与这条线相同？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q8: We choose four numbers from…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第8题：我们从1、3、4、5 和7…

content.en: We choose four numbers from 1, 3, 4, 5, and 7. We write one number in each square so that the equation is correct. Which number is not chosen? Kita memilih empat nombor daripada 1, 3, 4, 5, dan 7. Kita tuliskan satu nombor di dalam
content.zh: 我们从1、3、4、5 和7 中选四个数字。然后，我们在每一个格子里写上一个数字，让 这个等式变得正确。请问哪个数字没被选中？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q9: In the country of Gemland…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第9题：在宝石城这个国家里，你可以用一颗…

content.en: In the country of Gemland you can trade three diamonds for one ruby, or one diamond for two ﬂowers. How many ﬂowers can be traded for two rubies? Di negara Gemland kita boleh tukarkan tiga berlian untuk satu delima, atau satu berlian
content.zh: 在宝石城这个国家里，你可以用一颗红宝石换取三颗钻石，或者用一颗钻石换取两朵 花。请问两颗红宝石可以换取几朵花？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 Q10: Jim and Ben sat on the…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -1 第10题：如图所示，Jim 和Ben…

content.en: Jim and Ben sat on the Ferris wheel as in the picture below. The Ferris wheel turned and Ben was moved to the place where Jim was before. At that moment, where was Jim? Jim dan Ben duduk di atas roda Ferris seperti pada gambar di bawah. Roda Ferris terse-
content.zh: 如图所示，Jim 和Ben 坐在摩天轮上。摩天轮旋转后，Ben 已经被移到Jim 原本的位置 上。请问这时候Jim 在哪里？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q11: Alfred is rotating a shape…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第11题：Alfred…

content.en: Alfred is rotating a shape six times. The ﬁrst three rotations are shown in the picture. How does the shape look like at the end? Alfred memutarkan suatu bentuk sebanyak enam kali. Tiga putaran yang pertama ditun-
content.zh: Alfred 正在旋转着一个形状六次。前三次的旋转已经被显示在图中。请问那个形状最后 看起来是怎样的？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q12: Which picture has twice as…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第12题：请问以下哪个图片中苹果的数量是萝…

content.en: Which picture has twice as many apples as there are carrots, and twice as many carrots as there are pears? Gambar yang manakah menunjukkan bilangan epal dua kali ganda bilangan lobak merah,
content.zh: 请问以下哪个图片中苹果的数量是萝卜的数量的两倍，并且萝卜的数量是梨的数量的两 倍？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q13: Brian and William stand in…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第13题：Brian 和William…

content.en: Brian and William stand in line. Brian knows that there are 7 people in front of him. William knows that there are 11 people in the line. If Brian is just in front of William, how many people in the line are behind William?
content.zh: Brian 和William 在一起排队。Brian 知道他前面有7 个人。William 知道这一排总共 有11 个人。请问如果Brian 是站在William 前面的那一位，那么有多少人站在William 的

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q14: Now it is half past one…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第14题：现在是一点半。请问两个半小时之前…

content.en: Now it is half past one o’clock. What time was it two and a half hours ago? Waktu sekarang menunjukkan jam satu setengah. Apakah waktu pada dua jam setengah yang lalu?
content.zh: 现在是一点半。请问两个半小时之前是什么时间？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q15: Sepehr has two paperboards.…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第15题：Sepehr…

content.en: Sepehr has two paperboards. He colored one side of each paperboard like the following. Which shape can he make using both paperboards? Sepehr mempunyai dua keratan kertas.
content.zh: Sepehr 有两张卡片。他把每张卡片的其中一面涂成下图的样子。请问他可以用这两张卡 片排成怎样的形状？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q16: A kangaroo makes 10 jumps…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第16题：一只袋鼠在1 分钟内跳10…

content.en: A kangaroo makes 10 jumps in 1 minute and rests for 3 minutes. Then he again makes 10 jumps in 1 minute and rests for 3 minutes, and so on. What is the least amount of minutes that he needs to make 30 jumps?
content.zh: 一只袋鼠在1 分钟内跳10 次后再休息3 分钟。然后，它又在1 分钟内跳10 次后再休 息3 分钟，以此类推。请问它需要最少多少分钟来跳30 次？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q17: Which stamp has been used…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第17题：请问哪个印章可以印出下图？

content.en: Which stamp has been used to get the picture below? Cop yang manakah telah digunakan untuk mendapatkan gambar di bawah?
content.zh: 请问哪个印章可以印出下图？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q18: Each of the 4 keys ﬁts one…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第18题：每一把钥匙可以打开其中一把锁。钥…

content.en: Each of the 4 keys ﬁts one of the 4 padlocks. The numbers on the keys refer to the letters on the padlocks. What is written on the last padlock? Setiap satu kunci yang berikut hanya boleh membuka satu mangga. Nombor-nombor pada
content.zh: 每一把钥匙可以打开其中一把锁。钥匙上的号码代表着锁上的字母。请问最后一把锁上 写着什么？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q19: In Old McDonald’s barn…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第19题：在Old McDonald…

content.en: In Old McDonald’s barn there are one horse, two cows and three goats. How many more cows does the barn need so that the number of all animals is twice the number of cows? Di kandang Old McDonald terdapat seekor kuda, dua ekor lembu dan tiga ekor kambing.
content.zh: 在Old McDonald 的农场里养着一匹马、两头牛和三只羊。请问农场还需要多少头牛才 能使到所有动物的总数量是牛的总数量的两倍？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 Q20: Given three cards with…
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2017 – Level 1 -2 第20题：给定三张有洞的卡片。每一张卡片上…

content.en: Given three cards with holes. The top of each card is white and the bottom is grey. Basil puts a string through the holes, as in the ﬁgure below. By arranging the cards, which ﬁgure is possible to get?
content.zh: 给定三张有洞的卡片。每一张卡片上面是白色的，下面是灰色的。如图所示，Basil 把一 条线穿过每一个洞。请问他通过排列那些卡片，有可能获得以下哪一项？
